correctness.rationale: The exact labelled update depends only on outside-shore counts: q_i maps to n,0,or retained q_i according to whether sum_{j != i}q_j is above, below,or equal to n. The classification by 0/1/2/3 tied shores yields all fixed states 2+1_{2|n}binom(n,n/2)^3, 3(2^n-2) distinct primitive two-cycles, and entry within two updates, sharp for n>=3. Unique strict-between tied shore gives B_n=3 sum_a binom(n,a)^2 sum_{b=min(a,n-a)+1}^{max(a,n-a)-1} binom(n,b). Hypergeometric/binomial conditional CLT and Gaussian orthant signs give rare oscillation 6 pi^-3/2 atan(1/sqrt2) n^-1/2 and persistent reversal 1-(3/pi)atan(sqrt2). Independent weighted count-state census for n=1..8 confirmed exact B_n [0,12,36,660,3180,38172,218904,2266164] and all fixed/periodic counts. Finite census is corroboration, not an infinite proof.
